name: Ketazolam
summary: The drug is a benzodiazepine derivative, that is reported to have similar effects to diazepam, with reportedly milder side-effects. The drug is marketed in a few countries.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: It possesses anxiolytic, anticonvulsant, sedative and skeletal muscle relaxant properties.

uses.text: It is used for the treatment of anxiety and has similar effectiveness compared to diazepam. Ketazolam also appears to produce reduced levels of side effects such as sedation compared with diazepam and the side effects when they occur tend to be milder. Ketazolam is also an effective antispasmodic drug and is used for the treatment of spasticity.
